source.label: Gottlieb Slick Chick factory instruction cards

strategy.overview: Slick Chick scores most reliably through its six lanes and three standup targets. Plunge a top lane, shoot the two reachable side standups on the fly, and keep the ball among the five bumpers. The center gobble hole scores 100 but ends the ball, so pursue the S-L-I-C-K C-H-I-C-K and numbered-rollover Special routes only when their configured award is valuable.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Slick Chick, plunge a top lane and keep shooting toward the upper bumpers. Score the two reachable side standups whenever a moving ball gives you the angle. Avoid the center gobble hole because it ends the ball; work the letter and numbered-rollover sequences only when Special or replay converts to useful points.
strategy.summary: Ball time matters more than forcing the letter sequence. The side standups and six lanes supply the dependable points; bumper action supplies them indirectly. Stay alert when a fast return hits the hard rubber below a flipper because it may rebound back into play.

quickInfo.name: Lanes and standups
quickInfo.summary: The six lanes and three standup targets provide most of the repeatable tournament points.

quickInfo.name: S-L-I-C-K C-H-I-C-K
quickInfo.summary: Completing the rotating bumper letters lights one rollover button and resets the letters.

quickInfo.name: Numbered rollovers
quickInfo.summary: Collecting all four in order lights them for Special and can award a replay.

quickInfo.name: Gobble hole
quickInfo.summary: The center hole scores its shown value but ends the current ball.

steps.text: Plunge for either top lane, prioritizing a lane not yet collected when the rollover sequence matters.
Send the ball into the five bumpers and nudge for exits toward a lane or side standup.
Shoot either reachable side standup on the fly when the ball arrives with a clean angle.
Keep both flippers ready after hard-rubber rebounds below their tips; the ball may cross back into play.
Avoid the center gobble hole unless its Special conversion or immediate value is worth ending the ball.
Use the skill shot for one upper lane.
Keep the ball among the bumpers for more lane and target contacts.
Take reachable side standups without forcing the ball-ending center hole.

machineSetup: Confirm Special and replay conversion, the four-number order, and how the installed card values the gobble hole as more rollover buttons become lit.
Test all five bumpers and rotating letters, six lanes, three standups, five rollover-button lamps, four numbered rollovers, gobble-hole switch, and tilt sensitivity.
